description: This file contains shell functions for managing UBI volumes and environment configuration on a specific hardware platform (bcm4908). It includes functions for reading binary data, setting up environment configs, verifying and managing UBI volumes, and handling firmware metadata sequences.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte little-endian hexadecimal value from a file at a specified offset.

methods.name: bcm4908_pkgtb_setup_env_config
methods.description: Sets up environment configuration by reading UBI volume size and creating an environment config file.

methods.name: bcm4908_committed_image_seq
methods.description: Retrieves the committed image sequence number from environment metadata.

methods.name: bcm4908_verify_rootfs_data
methods.description: Verifies that the 'rootfs_data' UBI volume matches the current firmware image, wiping and claiming it if necessary.
